passages.passage_text: Psa 25:5 Lead me in your truth and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation ; for you I wait all the day long. Psa 25:6 Remember your mercy , O Lord , and your steadfast love , for they have been from of old . Psa 25:7 Remember not the sins of my youth or my transgressions ; according to your steadfast love remember me, for the sake of your goodness , O Lord ! Psa 25:8 Good and upright is the Lord ; therefore he instructs sinners in the way . Psa 25:9 He leads the humble in what is right , and teaches the humble his way . Psa 25:10 All the paths of the Lord are steadfast love and faithfulness , for those who keep his covenant and his testimonies . Psa 25:11 For your name’s sake , O Lord , pardon my guilt , for it is great . Psa 25:12 Who is the man who fears the Lord ? Him will he instruct in the way that he should choose . Psa 25:13 His soul shall abide in well-being , and his offspring shall inherit the land . Psa 25:14 The friendship of the Lord is for those who fear him, and he makes known to them his covenant . Psa 25:15 My eyes are ever toward the Lord , for he will pluck my feet out of the net . Psa 25:16 Turn to me and be gracious to me, for I am lonely and afflicted . Psa 25:17 The troubles of my heart are enlarged ; bring me out of my distresses . Psa 25:18 Consider my affliction and my trouble , and forgive all my sins . Psa 25:19 Consider how many are my foes , and with what violent hatred they hate me . Psa 25:20 Oh, guard my soul , and deliver me! Let me not be put to shame , for I take refuge in you . Psa 25:21 May integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you ^ . Psa 25:22 Redeem Israel , O God , out of all his troubles .

dimensions.label: sense
dimensions.value: pardon my guilt, for it is great

dimensions.label: operation
dimensions.value: the self asks pardon for its guilt, honestly owning that it is great - confession without minimising

dimensions.label: discovery
dimensions.value: v11: 'For your name's sake, O LORD, PARDON my GUILT, for it is GREAT' - the operation is unflinching confession: the interior does not shrink the sin but names it great and appeals to God's name.

passages.passage_text: A Maskil of David . Psa 32:1 Blessed is the one whose transgression is forgiven , whose sin is covered . Psa 32:2 Blessed is the man against whom the Lord counts no iniquity , and in whose spirit there is no deceit . Psa 32:3 For when I kept silent , my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long. Psa 32:4 For day and night your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was dried up as by the heat of summer . Selah Psa 32:5 I acknowledged my sin to you, and I did not cover my iniquity ; I said , “I will confess my transgressions to the Lord ,” and you forgave the iniquity of my sin . Selah Psa 32:6 Therefore let everyone who is godly offer prayer to you at a time when you may be found ; surely in the rush of great waters , they shall not reach him. Psa 32:7 You are a hiding place for me; you preserve me from trouble ; you surround me with shouts of deliverance . Selah Psa 32:8 I will instruct you and teach you in the way you should go ; I will counsel you with my eye upon you. Psa 32:9 Be not like a horse or a mule , without understanding , which must be curbed with bit and bridle , or it will not stay near you . Psa 32:10 Many are the sorrows of the wicked , but steadfast love surrounds the one who trusts in the Lord . Psa 32:11 Be glad in the Lord , and rejoice , O righteous , and shout for joy , all you upright in heart !

dimensions.label: sense
dimensions.value: I confessed and did not cover it

dimensions.label: operation
dimensions.value: the self acknowledged its sin, did not cover its iniquity, resolved to confess - and God forgave - the decisive turn

dimensions.label: discovery
dimensions.value: v5: 'I ACKNOWLEDGED my sin to you, and I did not COVER my iniquity... I will CONFESS my transgressions, and you FORGAVE the iniquity of my sin' - the operation is the hinge of the psalm: the interior stops hiding and speaks, and forgiveness follows at once.

passages.passage_text: A Psalm of David , for the memorial offering . Psa 38:1 O Lord , rebuke me not in your anger , nor discipline me in your wrath ! Psa 38:2 For your arrows have sunk into me, and your hand has come down on me. Psa 38:3 There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation ; there is no health in my bones because of my sin . Psa 38:4 For my iniquities have gone over my head ; like a heavy burden , they are too heavy for me . Psa 38:5 My wounds stink and fester because of my foolishness , Psa 38:6 I am utterly bowed down and prostrate; all the day I go about mourning . Psa 38:7 For my sides are filled with burning , and there is no soundness in my flesh . Psa 38:8 I am feeble and crushed ; I groan because of the tumult of my heart . Psa 38:9 O Lord , all my longing is before you; my sighing is not hidden from you. Psa 38:10 My heart throbs ; my strength fails me, and the light of my eyes — it also has gone from me . Psa 38:11 My friends and companions stand aloof from my plague , and my nearest kin stand far off. Psa 38:12 Those who seek my life lay their snares ; those who seek my hurt speak of ruin and meditate treachery all day long. Psa 38:13 But I am like a deaf man; I do not hear , like a mute man who does not open his mouth . Psa 38:14 I have become like a man who does not hear , and in whose mouth are no rebukes . Psa 38:15 But for you, O Lord , do I wait ; it is you, O Lord my God , who will answer . Psa 38:16 For I said , “Only let them not rejoice over me, who boast against me when my foot slips !” Psa 38:17 For I am ready to fall , and my pain is ever before me. Psa 38:18 I confess my iniquity ; I am sorry for my sin . Psa 38:19 But my foes are vigorous , they are mighty , and many are those who hate me wrongfully . Psa 38:20 Those who render me evil for good accuse me because I follow after good . Psa 38:22 Make haste to help me, O Lord, my salvation!

dimensions.label: sense
dimensions.value: I confess my iniquity, I am sorry for my sin

dimensions.label: operation
dimensions.value: the self confesses its iniquity and is sorry for its sin - penitence spoken and felt

dimensions.label: discovery
dimensions.value: v18: 'I CONFESS my iniquity; I am SORRY for my sin' - the operation is the penitent turn: the interior names its guilt and grieves it, not merely its consequences.
